purpose: Testing Desk bundle of five small jobs (TIE3 lists, WXDAYEND_A, UNRATE lists, POL-i2 stage 1 lists, SOCDERIV lists) so they cost one run; each request id is prefixed t3_, wx_, ur_, p2_, sd_.
heldout: none read; nothing closing on or after 2026-11-13T00:00Z (TIE3, SOCDERIV) or 2026-11-05T00:00Z (POL-i2) is requested; measurements and counts only, no rule scored, no try
notes: 204 requests, 486 pages at most (the runner counts pages against the cap); worst-case size is far above the 200 MB run cap if every page were full (see TESTING_LISTS_BUNDLE.md); sub-jobs are ordered so a size stop falls on the last one

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
